summary: Meta released version 0.0.4 of the llama-cookbook/llama-recipes repository, updating recipes and documentation to support the newly released Llama 3.2 models (1B, 3B, 11B, 90B) including multimodal finetuning.

practices.reason: Teams using the llama-recipes/cookbook toolkit would need to pull updated recipes and documentation to work with the new Llama 3.2 model sizes and multimodal finetuning support.
practices.quote: For this release we updated the documentation and made sure all components work with the new models including multimodal finetuning.
